newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to borrow abroad to help states - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to borrow abroad to help states - paper.

text.p: Brazil's National Treasury plans to borrow up to $1.0 billion in global debt markets to help the nation's indebted states pay their bills, O Globo newspaper reported.

The Treasury determined it had to borrow abroad because federal bank Caixa Economica, which has already loaned 2.5 billion reais ($2.45 billion) to states this year, has no more resources to offer, O Globo said, without citing a source for the information.
